ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption recovery sabotage chain — vssadmin + wbadmin + bcdedit + service stops
ucs.description: Hunts the tightly-clustered pre-encryption staging Qilin/Agenda affiliates execute minutes before dropping the encryptor: shadow-copy deletion, backup-catalog wipe, Windows Recovery Environment disable, and termination of Veeam/SQL/EDR services. Three or more of these actions in the same 10-minute window on one host is the Qilin operator playbook documented by Group-IB and Sophos X-Ops.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_actions min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND (Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*delete systemstatebackup*")) OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*stop*veeam*" OR Processes.process="*stop*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*stop*SQLAgent*" OR Processes.process="*Stop-Service*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*stop*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*stop*memtas*" OR Processes.process="*stop*mepocs*")) ) by host Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_actions>=3 AND NOT match(user,"\$$")
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup"))
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)recoveryenabled\s+no" or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stop|stop-service)\s+.*\b(veeam|mssql|sqlagent|backupexec|memtas|mepocs|sophos|sentinel|carbonblack)\b")
| summarize DistinctActions = dcount(FileName),
            Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where DistinctActions >= 3   // 3+ distinct recovery-sabotage binaries inside 10 min — Qilin playbook ceiling, baseline FP <1/wk per 10k hosts
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ImgName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| where (ImgName == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)delete\s+shadows")
     or (ImgName == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup)")
     or (ImgName == "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)")
     or (ImgName == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)shadowcopy.*delete")
     or (ImgName in ("net.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stop|stop-service)\s+.*\b(veeam|mssql|sqlagent|backupexec|memtas|mepocs|sophos|sentinel|carbonblack)\b")
| summarize DistinctActions = dcount(ImgName),
            Commands = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where DistinctActions >= 3
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"shadowcopy delete"*) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*stop*Veeam* OR *stop*veeam* OR *stop*MSSQL* OR *stop*BackupExec* OR *"Stop-Service"* OR *stop*memtas* OR *stop*mepocs*)) )
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(net|sc|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(stop|stop-service)\s+.*\b(veeam|mssql|sqlagent|backupexec|memtas|mepocs|sophos|sentinel|carbonblack)\b/i)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=distinct_actions), collect([CommandLine, ImageFileName]), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
| distinct_actions>=3
ucs.rationale: The combo of vssadmin shadow-delete + wbadmin catalog-delete + bcdedit recoveryenabled No + targeted termination of Veeam/MSSQL/backup services in under 10 minutes is the Qilin/Agenda affiliate manual — published in Group-IB's Qilin teardown and Sophos's August-2024 Agenda intrusion report — and is run by the encryptor stager (sometimes via a single .bat) before dropping the Rust/Go binary. ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin GPO-pushed Chrome/Edge credential harvester (Sophos-reported Agenda tradecraft)
ucs.description: Hunts PowerShell launched from a logon-script / Group Policy context that reads Chromium credential stores (Login Data / Local State / Cookies). This is the distinctive Qilin behaviour Sophos X-Ops reported in August 2024: after gaining DC access, Qilin operators push a credential-harvester PowerShell script via a GPO logon script in SYSVOL so every interactive logon across the domain dumps browser-stored credentials.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("userinit.exe","gpscript.exe","winlogon.exe") OR Processes.process="*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\NETLOGON\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Policies\\*") AND (Processes.process="*Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Local State*" OR Processes.process="*Edge\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*os_crypt*" OR Processes.process="*ProtectedData*" OR Processes.process="*DPAPI*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$")
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("userinit.exe","gpscript.exe","winlogon.exe")
     or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe")
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\NETLOGON\", @"\Policies\")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"Google\Chrome\User Data", "Login Data", "Local State", @"Edge\User Data", "os_crypt", "ProtectedData", "DPAPI", "masterkey")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Image       = FolderPath,
          Cmd         = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ImgName    = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| where ImgName in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ParentName in ("userinit.exe","gpscript.exe","winlogon.exe")
     or CommandLine has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\NETLOGON\", @"\Policies\")
| where CommandLine has_any (@"Google\Chrome\User Data", "Login Data", "Local State", @"Edge\User Data", "os_crypt", "ProtectedData", "DPAPI", "masterkey")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Qilin (Agenda) GPO-Pushed Chrome/Edge Credential Harvester
id: 9a4d6c3b-2e10-4f87-9a1d-7c2bd4ef0001
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell launched from a logon-script / Group Policy context that touches Chromium credential stores. Reported as Qilin (Agenda) ransomware tradecraft where operators push a credential-harvester logon script via SYSVOL after domain compromise.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2024/08/22
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1539
  - attack.t1037.001
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_logon_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\userinit.exe'
      - '\gpscript.exe'
      - '\winlogon.exe'
  selection_logon_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\SYSVOL\'
      - '\NETLOGON\'
      - '\Policies\'
  selection_browser_target:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Local State'
      - '\Edge\User Data'
      - 'os_crypt'
      - 'ProtectedData'
      - 'DPAPI'
  condition: selection_proc and (selection_logon_parent or selection_logon_path) and selection_browser_target
falsepositives:
  - Enterprise browser-profile maintenance scripts pushed via GPO (rare; confirm with the workstation team)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE) (@ParentImage:(*\\userinit.exe OR *\\Userinit.exe OR *\\USERINIT.EXE OR *\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPScript.exe OR *\\GPSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\winlogon.exe OR *\\Winlogon.exe OR *\\WINLOGON.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\* OR *\\NETLOGON\\* OR *\\netlogon\\* OR *\\Policies\\* OR *\\policies\\*)) @CommandLine:(*"Google\\Chrome\\User Data"* OR *"google\\chrome\\user data"* OR *"Login Data"* OR *"login data"* OR *"Local State"* OR *"local state"* OR *"Edge\\User Data"* OR *os_crypt* OR *ProtectedData* OR *DPAPI*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/(userinit|gpscript|winlogon)\.exe$/i
  OR CommandLine=/\\(SYSVOL|NETLOGON|Policies)\\/i
